data.name: SC_TccWriteFailedBodyFormat
data.value:
TCC offset could not be changed - the value remained at {0}°C.
This usually means: • Hyper-V/HVCI (Core Isolation) is blocking MSR writes • Secure Boot is preventing kernel-mode access
To fix: 1. Open Windows Security → Device Security → Core Isolation 2. Disable 'Memory Integrity' 3. Restart your computer
Or use Intel XTU which has a signed driver.

CPU power limits are locked by BIOS and cannot be modified.
This lock is set during boot and persists until the next restart. Some laptops may require specific BIOS settings or Unleashed Mode to unlock.
If you are on OMEN 16-am0xxx (8D2F) Intel Core Ultra, direct PL1/PL2 sliders may stay locked while OMEN/OGH performance mode policy still works.
